season.name: Summer
season.line: Labor without Sabbath becomes bondage, however fruitful it looks.

movement.name: The Eighth Day
movement.line: The work is done, and the rest remains.

days.t: God saw everything that he had made, and it was very good
x: And God saw all the things that he had made, and, behold, they were very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.

days.t: Establish the work of our hands
x: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and do thou direct for us the works of our hands.

days.t: You shall eat the labors of your hands
x: Thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands: blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.

days.t: The sleep of a servant is sweet
x: The sleep of a servant is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but to one who is satiated with wealth, there is none that suffers him to sleep.

days.t: Seek first the kingdom of God
x: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you⁺.

days.t: They rest from their labors, and their deeds follow them
x: And I heard a voice out of heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed [are] the dead who are dying in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “so that they will rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.”
